senses.gloss: yonānī (= Skt. yavanānī, Pat. on Pāṇ. 〔4.1.49〕, Vārt. 3), Greek writing, in a list of scripts; 〔§ 22.10〕; so read for mss. yonārī (Senart yāvanī, more remote and less plausible): Mv 〔i.135.5〕. Followed by brahma-vāṇī, for which LV 〔125.21〕 has brahmavali-lipi; and before this, Tib. on LV ya ba na-ḥi yi ge, writing of the Yavanas (not in Skt. text of LV). Cf. śakānī.
